audited_source_corrections.action: Changed the quantified parameter x in the pointwise-limit definition from the unit square to the unit line.
audited_source_corrections.source_issue_or_choice: The source says 'for each x in unitsquare' just before defining h(x), but later defines the curve as a map from unitline to R squared and consistently treats x as a line parameter.
audited_source_corrections.chosen_treatment: புள்ளிவாரி எல்லையின் அளபுருவை அலகுக் கோட்டில் எடுக்கிறது.
audited_source_corrections.alternatives_considered: Keeping a square-domain parameter would conflict with the stated definition of a curve and with every subsequent use of the unit interval.
audited_source_corrections.rationale: Each approximation h_n parametrizes a path by a point of the unit interval; the limit must have the same domain.
audited_source_corrections.precise_review_question: Should the parameter domain in the displayed pointwise-limit definition be the unit line?

audited_source_corrections.action: Retained the translated heuristic argument and appended a visible editorial note that its final neighbourhood construction does not prove continuity at a prescribed input and that pointwise convergence alone does not establish the claimed surjectivity.
audited_source_corrections.source_issue_or_choice: The source says the argument is hand-wavy, but later announces proofs of space-filling and continuity. Its final quantifiers fix an output p and find some input interval, whereas continuity must fix each input x0 and control outputs for inputs near x0. Its dense-approximation argument also has not established the convergence control needed to pass the covering property to the pointwise limit.
audited_source_corrections.chosen_treatment: மூலத்தின் விளக்கத்தை முழுவதும் வைத்தே, அது முழு நிறுவல் அல்ல என்பதைத் தெளிவாகக் குறிக்கும் பதிப்பாசிரியர் குறிப்பைச் சேர்க்கிறது.
audited_source_corrections.alternatives_considered: Silently presenting the heuristic as a complete proof; replacing it with a new proof outside the translation scope.
audited_source_corrections.rationale: The note preserves the historical exposition while preventing readers from mistaking a weaker neighbourhood property or unproved limit passage for the claimed theorems.
audited_source_corrections.precise_review_question: Does the note accurately distinguish the informal construction from a proof of continuity at each input and surjectivity of the limit map?
